hits.title: JetBrains previews no-code app builder | InfoWorld
hits.snippet: JetBrains is offering early access to Kineto, an AI-powered, no-code development platform intended to help anybody create professional or personal apps regardless of technical ability. Launched [August 5](https://blog.jetbrains.com/kineto/2025/08/make-your-ideas-clickable-with-kineto-by-jetbrains/) , Kineto helps users create, deploy, and maintain ready-to-use websites and small “single-value” apps without writing a single line of code, JetBrains said. These apps could include a portfolio website, a family budget planner, or the next big app, the company noted. Interested participants can join the waitlist at [kineto.dev](https://kineto.dev/) . With Kineto, JetBrains said it was building a bridge between creative people, small businesses, and no-code platforms to open new era in which people will create their own personal web apps with minimal effort. “The key principle behind Kineto is no code for you at all,” the blog post introducing Kineto said. “We and our tools take care of the coding, so you could focus on being creative.
